title: Very loud
text: Very loud. Sure, it fits nicely in a corner but the price is your hearing. This is a very loud fan. The lowest speed doesn't blow much so you need to put on at least 2. There is no remote control. It does an ok job with moving air.

product_metadata.title: PELONIS 3-in-1 Evaporative Air Cooler, Tower Fan & Humidifier 563 CFM, 215 sq ft, 90° Wide Range Coverage, Timer, Remote Control, 3 Quiet Speeds,3 Mode Settings, 5L Water Tank, Includes 2 Ice Packs
features: Fan-Cooler-Humidifier in One: This portable air cooler pulls hot, dry air through the water-soaked filter using a fan to decrease the ambient temperature in your living room, bedroom, and office or any indoor space where cooling relief is needed. It does not use refrigerants like an air conditioner. This Evaporative Air Cooler will also increase humidity in the air when used in arid climates. It is a cost effective solution compared to other traditional cooling units.

Comes Nicely Equipped – Swamp Cooler has 3 fan speeds (H/M/L) and 3 wind modes (normal/natural/sleep) let's you customize your comfort. 60-degree oscillation allows for a wide, even distribution of airflow. Featured with a 7-hour timer and with a convenient remote control, allows you to set the room cooler from the bed or couch. No assembly required.

Easy-to-Use – This stylish and compact portable Air cooler is 11.6 x 9.1 x 33.6 inches and blends into any room décor without taking up a lot of floor space. To have some air circulating, just turn on the fan. To humidify dry air, simply add water to the tank and turn on the fan with humidifier function. To cool the air, cool the water by adding the included ice packs or ice cubes from the freezer.

Easy To Maintain – The 5L water tank can last for minimum 8 hours and is removable for convenient refilling at the sink. The built-in handle design lets you transport the Air cooler to wherever you need it most. The detachable filter on the back of the unit can be removed for regular cleaning and maintenance ensuring airflow is germ-free.

Manufacturer Warranty – Pelonis proudly offers a 1-year manufacturer warranty on your purchase of any of our products. This Evaporative Air Cooler is 12v and comes with a two-pronged electric plug. Get your 3-in-1 Evaporative Air Cooler today.
